sales_backpressure_enabled.summary: Throttle how many orders a shopper can place in a short window.

sales_backpressure_guest_limit.summary: Maximum order attempts a single guest may make per period.

sales_backpressure_limit.summary: Maximum order attempts a signed-in customer may make per period.

sales_backpressure_period.summary: The window over which order-placement attempts are counted.

sales_cancellation_enabled.summary: Let customers cancel their own orders through the GraphQL API.

sales_cancellation_reasons.summary: The list of reasons a customer can pick when cancelling an order.

sales_dashboard_use_aggregated_data.summary: Use pre-aggregated statistics for the admin dashboard charts.
sales_dashboard_use_aggregated_data.usage: When Yes, the dashboard reads from aggregated report tables — much faster, but the figures are only as fresh as the last statistics refresh. When No, it queries live data, which is accurate but slower on large stores.

sales_general_hide_customer_ip.summary: Hide the customer's IP address on order documents.

sales_gift_options_allow_items.summary: Let shoppers add a gift message to individual order items.

sales_gift_options_allow_order.summary: Let shoppers add a single gift message to the whole order.

sales_identity_address.summary: The store address printed on invoices, shipments and credit memos.

sales_identity_logo.summary: The logo printed on PDF sales documents.

sales_identity_logo_html.summary: The logo shown on the HTML (on-screen) print view.

sales_instant_purchase_active.summary: Offer one-click Instant Purchase using a stored payment method.

sales_instant_purchase_button_text.summary: The label shown on the Instant Purchase button.

sales_minimum_order_active.summary: Require orders to reach a minimum amount before checkout.

sales_minimum_order_amount.summary: The smallest order value a customer may check out with.
sales_minimum_order_amount.usage: The minimum order value required to place an order, measured as the subtotal after discount. Applies only when the minimum-order rule is enabled.

sales_minimum_order_description.summary: The cart message shown while an order is below the minimum.

sales_minimum_order_error_message.summary: The error shown when a below-minimum order is attempted.

sales_minimum_order_include_discount_amo.summary: Measure the minimum against the subtotal after discounts.

sales_minimum_order_multi_address.summary: Apply the minimum to each address in multi-address checkout.

sales_minimum_order_multi_address_descri.summary: The cart message for below-minimum multi-address orders.

sales_minimum_order_multi_address_error_.summary: The error for below-minimum multi-address orders.

sales_minimum_order_tax_including.summary: Count tax toward the minimum order amount.

sales_msrp_display_price_type.summary: When to reveal the actual price on products that use MAP.

sales_msrp_enabled.summary: Turn on Minimum Advertised Price handling store-wide.
sales_msrp_enabled.usage: When Yes, products can hide their price under MAP rules and reveal it later. Warning: enabling MAP by default hides every storefront price until each product is configured.

sales_msrp_explanation_message.summary: The popup text explaining why a price is hidden.

sales_msrp_explanation_message_whats_thi.summary: The text behind the MAP "What's this?" link.

sales_orders_delete_pending_after.summary: How long an unpaid pending order survives before cancellation.

sales_reorder_allow.summary: Let customers reorder a past order from their account.

sales_totals_sort_subtotal.summary: The position of the Subtotal line in the totals block.

sales_totals_sort_discount.summary: The position of the Discount line in the totals block.

sales_totals_sort_shipping.summary: The position of the Shipping line in the totals block.

sales_totals_sort_tax.summary: The position of the Tax line in the totals block.

sales_totals_sort_weee.summary: The position of the Fixed Product Tax line in the totals block.

sales_totals_sort_grand_total.summary: The position of the Grand Total line in the totals block.

sales_zerograndtotal_creditmemo_allow_ze.summary: Allow credit memos whose total is zero.
sales_zerograndtotal_creditmemo_allow_ze.usage: When Yes, a credit memo can be created even when its total is zero — for example when refunding only non-monetary items. When No, zero-total credit memos are blocked.
